sentences.text: Brian Russell De Palma -LRB- born September 11 , 1940 -RRB- is an American film director and screenwriter .
He is considered part of the New Hollywood wave of filmmaking .	New Hollywood	New Hollywood
In a career spanning over 50 years , he is best known for his suspense , psychological thriller , and crime films .	suspense	suspense	psychological thriller	psychological thriller

He directed successful and popular films such as the supernatural horror Carrie , the erotic crime thriller Dressed to Kill , the thriller Blow Out , the crime dramas Scarface , The Untouchables , and Carlito 's Way , and the action spy film Mission : Impossible .
